services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We create detailed plans and render visuals so you know exactly what's coming.

services.title: Paving & Hardscaping
services.desc: Professional patio installation, decking, pathways, and driveways. Quality materials and precise installation ensure long-lasting results.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert plant selection and border design for year-round colour and interest. We handle soil preparation and ongoing care advice.

services.title: Fencing & Screening
services.desc: New fence installation, repairs, and bespoke screening solutions. We work with timber, composite, and metal options for privacy and style.

services.title: Water Features & Lighting
services.desc: Garden ponds, fountains, and outdoor lighting installations to enhance your garden's ambiance and usability after dark.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Maintenance
services.desc: Overgrown garden rescue, seasonal maintenance, hedge trimming, and seasonal tidy-ups to keep your outdoor space in top condition.

about_pullquote: We build gardens people actually want to spend time in, not just look at.
about_para_1: Venture Landscaping was founded in 2012 by a team passionate about turning ordinary gardens into outdoor rooms. Over a decade, we've completed more than 400 projects across Leicester and the surrounding areas, from small residential plots to commercial landscapes. Our approach combines thoughtful design with skilled craftsmanship and attention to detail.
about_para_2: We pride ourselves on listening to our clients and delivering exactly what they've imagined. Word-of-mouth referrals and repeat business form the heart of our work—we treat every garden as if it were our own. Whether you're starting from scratch or refreshing a tired space, we'll guide you through every stage and make sure the result exceeds your expectations.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Venture Landscaping

reviews.text: Fantastic team. We had a blank canvas of a garden and weren't sure where to start. They came up with a brilliant design, kept costs realistic, and the work was finished on time. The garden looks nothing like it did before—our neighbours keep asking who did it!
reviews.author: Michelle T.

reviews.text: Had our old patio ripped up and a new composite deck installed. The lads were tidy, professional, and knew exactly what they were doing. Took them three days start to finish. Really happy with the result and fair pricing.
reviews.author: David R.

reviews.text: We needed the garden sorting after years of neglect. They cleared everything, put in new borders, and designed a sensible planting scheme. It's already looking great and they gave us solid advice on maintenance so we can keep it looking good ourselves.
reviews.author: Emma K.
